reads.stopped_at: The connection starts the process; it does not make the entire drive searchable immediately.
reads.what_it_sells: Portway is software that indexes files in a connected shared drive so I can search them from one workspace during my week.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I am a new account administrator who signed up but has not connected a drive, so the requested first connection directly matches my current stage. The email additionally presupposes that I have a supported shared drive, permission to connect it, and readiness to begin indexing; those details are unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I have signed up for Portway and have not yet connected a drive.
Email-only: I have access to a shared drive that Portway supports.
Email-only: I have the authority and required permissions to let Portway index that drive.
Email-only: I am ready to start indexing at least the first folder now.
reads.problem_now: Connecting a drive is the documented next setup step, but the profile establishes no urgent need for search today. With a meeting in three minutes, this is relevant but not an immediate problem.
reads.biggest_doubt: I do not know which drive services are supported, what access Portway will request, or whether connecting it is a quick and reversible admin action. I would not start an organization-level connection without those basics.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me which drive providers are supported, what permissions Portway requests, and roughly how long the connection setup takes.
fixes: Cut the repetition in “The connection starts the process; it does not make the entire drive searchable immediately. There is no need to wait for the whole drive to finish before using search.” Replace it with: “You can search each folder as soon as Portway finishes indexing it.”

Rewrite “Start the connection when you are ready for the first folder to begin indexing.” to state the practical commitment: “Connect a supported drive when you have [estimated setup time]; before indexing begins, you can review the folders and permissions Portway will access.”
Rewrite “Connect a drive →” to make the destination clearer: “Review permissions and connect a drive →”
